thread:
incident-bot: Paging oncall-eu: P99 latency spike detected for streaming responses in eu-west2 (service: inference-stream). Alerts: p99 tokens > 1.2s for last 5m, streaming stalls >= 3%

oncall-eu: Acked. I'm up. Looking now.

ravi.k: seeing same in dashboards — spike aligns with a NAT gateway error budget anomaly and increased TLS handshake times from eu-west2->eu-west3 cross-zone path. p95 jumped to 220ms, p99 ~1.25s. Streaming stalls graph: https://grafana.redwood/inference/streams?panel=stall-rate

marta: worth noting client reconnects increased, some customers saw partial responses then stalls. CX ticket #12345 incoming.

sam: can someone post the infra alert payload?

incident-bot: Alert details: metric="streaming_tail_latency.p99" value=1.26s window=5m tags=[region:eu-west2, model:gptx-7b, route:streaming]

leah: quick triage plan: 1) check NAT ephemeral port exhaustion + packet loss 2) check cross-zone routing flaps 3) validate TLS handshake latencies 4) consider fallback to dedicated route or route to eu-west1 for impacted customers

oncall-eu: running basic checks now. `gcloud compute routers get-status nat-gw-eu-west2 --region eu-west2`

netops-bot: NAT ephemeral port utilization=78%, active connections spiked from 30k->110k in last 10m, NAT error rate=0.8% (conn failures).

ravi.k: tcpdump on lb->nat shows increased retransmits and slow TLS handshakes (handshake RTT ~600-800ms). Could be cross-zone MTU/path or packet loss. Running `mtr -r -c 50 eu-west3-vip` from a pod in eu-west2.

marta: confirmed DNS latencies also up for eu-west2 -> external resolvers, p95 DNS ~120ms (baseline ~20ms). Might explain slow handshake start times.

sam: hmm, any config changes deployed in last 30m? eng-releases shows no infra deploys. Route table updates?

eng-sre: just pulled VPC flow logs, seeing increased retransmit rate on inter-zone VXLAN overlay between azb/azc in eu-west2 cluster. Packet loss spikes 1.2% on those paths correlating to the time window.

leah: customer impact? Marta, CX details?

marta: early list: 3 enterprise customers on dedicated capacity rerouted via eu-west2, 1 PLG customer experiencing streaming disconnects. Estimated affected requests ~4.5k in window. SLA risk: yes for streaming p99 target (SLO breached for 5m).

oncall-eu: I'm going to fail traffic to eu-west1 for high-risk customers as a quick mitigation. Will update routing policy to prefer eu-west1 for client tags `tier:enterprise` and `region:eu-west` — applying policy now. `redwoodctl route update --policy=prefer-eu-west1 --selector="tier=enterprise,region=eu-west"`

ravi.k: while routing fails over, we should probe NAT GW health. Can we rotate/maximize ephemeral ports? Options: 1) increase NAT port range 2) attach additional NAT instance 3) rebuild NAT instance. Which is fastest?

netops-bot: Provision additional NAT instance in eu-west2 requested (opt-in warm pool). ETA ~3m to attach as active.

leah: also flip fallback for streaming path to non-TLS optimized variant to reduce handshake cost? Risky. Prefer routing customers to eu-west1 first.

eng-sre: rolling transient mitigation: increase tcp_retries2 to reduce noisy retransmit storms? I'm hesitant. Instead will bump keepalive to keep connections from opening/closing frequently.

marta: CX note posted: "We're investigating intermittent streaming delays in EU region. Some customers may see slow token generation or reconnects. We'll provide updates as we have them." :warning:

oncall-eu: routing policy applied. Confirming traffic shift metrics... traffic for enterprise->eu-west1 increased by ~82% for the affected routes. Latency for those customers is back to baseline.

ravi.k: NAT extra instance is attached. Ephemeral port usage dropped to 45% after attach. NAT error rate dropped to 0.12%.

sam: streaming p99 dropped from 1.26s to 320ms after routing + NAT attach. Stalls down from 3% -> 0.4%.

leah: good. Now we need root cause. Eng-sre, netops: collect pcap, tcpdump, VPC flow logs for the 20m window and check for device queue drops, interface errors. Also check possible software bug in VXLAN overlay or cloud NAT scaling bug.

eng-sre: grabbing pcaps: `kubectl exec -n infra nat-gw-collector -- tcpdump -w /tmp/nat-window.pcap 'host eu-west3-vip'` and saving to s3 `s3://redwood-incident-pcaps/1919999999/`

netops-bot: VPC flow logs show increases in `REJECT` and `DROP` on the path between azb->azc during spike; cloud provider incident for inter-az routing in eu-west2 at ~1919999800 reported. Link: https://status.cloudprovider.com/incidents/ew2-routing (internal note).

ravi.k: That matches. So chain: cloud inter-AZ routing instability -> packet loss -> retransmits -> TLS handshake stalls and NAT ephemeral port pressure (due to connection churn) -> increased p99 streaming latency and stalls.

marta: CX update: "We've mitigated impact by rerouting enterprise traffic to eu-west1; NAT scaling reduced error rates. We're investigating root cause with cloud provider. No data leak, just availability/latency"

leah: next actions (post-incident): 1) timeline & RCA with cloud provider ticket 2) add automated failover to prefer intra-az routing or fallback regions earlier when inter-az retransmit / packet loss > 0.5% 3) consider pre-warmed NAT instance pool for eu regions 4) follow up on streaming client backoff heuristics to reduce reconnect storm.

oncall-eu: handing off to eng-sre for deep investigation and RCA. I'm going offline for the rotation. @eng-sre please take over and post a summary by EOD.

eng-sre: taking over. I'll coordinate with netops to pull full logs and open provider ticket.

incident-bot: Incident timeline created: incident/1919999999 (severity: high) — responders: oncall-eu, eng-sre, netops-bot, ravi.k, marta, sam.

marta: recording customer impact metrics for SLO trigger: p99 breach duration=7m, affected requests=~5.4k, estimated revenue risk low (no chargebacks yet) but SLA incident flagged.

leah: thanks everyone. If eng-sre needs more help ping me. Otherwise we'll prepare an internal postmortem and a customer-facing incident note once RCA confirmed. :white_check_mark:

eng-sre: I'll post updates in this thread and attach pcap + graphs when ready. Closing the pages for oncall-eu.

marta: TY all.

-- end of thread --
